slot_scores.name: missing_objective
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked about the optimization objective or goal of the planning problem.

slot_scores.name: mandatory_repair_after_each_stage
slot_scores.rationale: The agent did not explicitly ask whether all tools used in a stage must be sent for repair after that stage.

slot_scores.name: fast_repair_return_timing
slot_scores.evidence_quote: When a tool is sent for fast repair at the end of stage j, does it become available at the start of stage j+q (usable during stage j+q), or at the start of stage j+q+1 (first usable in stage j+q+1)?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the exact timing when fast-repaired tools become available.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: The objective is to minimize cost spent on tools during the planning period.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about or confirmed the optimization objective before proceeding with cost-focused questions.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Tools used in a stage must be sent for repair at the end of that stage.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent asked about repair timing and availability but never explicitly confirmed that repair after each stage is mandatory for all used tools.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The conversation ended without a READY_TO_MODEL or equivalent final modeling state, and P0/P1 slots H1 and H2 remained unresolved.

summary: The agent recovered fast-repair return timing but failed to ask about the core objective and mandatory repair rule, then repeated the same low-value question many times without reaching a final modeling state.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
